interpretation.no_relevant_in_top10: No candidate with relevance >= 2 in Top-10; candidate-generation/retrieval failure at this cutoff.
interpretation.relevant_only_in_ranks_6_to_10: A relevant candidate exists but ranking places it below Top-5.
interpretation.relevant_in_top5_but_not_top1: A relevant candidate is retrievable but Top-1 ranking is incorrect.
interpretation.relevant_at_top1_only_or_sparse: Top-1 is relevant, but additional Top-5 relevance is sparse.
interpretation.relevant_at_top1_with_additional_top5_re: Top-1 is relevant and at least one additional relevant result is present in Top-5.

limitations: These categories describe ranking behavior, not visual root causes.
Angle, lighting, crop, background, and fine-grained design causes require image-level inspection.
One annotator means inter-annotator agreement is unavailable.
This analysis uses validation annotations and does not use test labels for model selection.
